title: Backward-facing step, Re_D = 800 (Gartling), Hex-dominant (2D)

setup.words: A backward-facing step channel: an inlet channel h = 5 mm high and 100 mm long on top of a step S = 5 mm, then a channel H = 10 mm high and 300 mm (30 H) long after it (expansion ratio 2), 5 mm deep in z (one cell across) (STEP in mm, built with OCP: two boxes fused and unified); a custom fluid with nu = 1.25e-05 m²/s and rho = 1 kg/m³, so Re_D = U_b 2h / nu = 800; a uniform velocity inlet of 1 m/s normal to the face, a 0 Pa pressure outlet, every wall no-slip (the floor after the step and the top wall BCs of their own), the front and back one Symmetry (the 2D mesh's ends, solved empty); laminar, steady (simpleFoam, SIMPLEC), Accurate numerics, residual targets 1e-6, at most 6000 iterations.

geometry.builder: backward-facing step channel: an inlet channel h = 5 mm high and 100 mm long on top of a step S = 5 mm, then a channel H = 10 mm high and 300 mm (30 H) long after it (expansion ratio 2), 5 mm deep in z (one cell across)

estimate.n_cells_note: an order of magnitude of the 2D mesh (one cell across), not a prediction

setup.mesh_words: Hex-dominant at fineness 10, One cell across (2D) on, a custom size of 0.3 mm on every wall with Refine out to 5 mm (half the height: the whole channel), no wall layers; 1 non-orthogonal corrector

rows.text: The run starts from rest; starting from potential flow shortens the start-up.

estimate.line: 6,000 iterations at most · ~8 minutes on 8 cores · Re ≈ 800

written.label: Velocity limit
written.value: 50 m/s (at least 50 m/s; 10 × 1 m/s (inlet Inlet) is less)

written.label: Velocity gradient
written.value: grad(U) skew-corrected (Gauss skewCorrected linear) inside the gradient limiter; linearUpwind and the viscous terms read it

written.label: Flux interpolation
written.value: flux(HbyA) skewCorrected linear; the rest linear

written.label: Solver types
written.value: GAMG for p, smoothSolver (symGaussSeidel) for U

findings.text: It ended without its residuals meeting their targets: its results may not have settled.

histories.label: U_x in the floor's bubble (the first Bubble probe)

quantities.label: Primary reattachment on the floor, x_r/S (Re_D 800)

uncertainty.what: half the spacing of the two face centres around the zero

quantities.how: the x component of the wall shear stress the run saved on the floor after the step (wallShearStress, one face per x on the 2D mesh), its sign in the attached flow far after the step (0.6 to 0.9 of the length after it) taken as forward; x_r where it turns from reversed to forward at the end of its longest reversed stretch, the primary eddy from the step's foot (a corner eddy's forward flow at the foot, if any, is passed over), the zero linearly interpolated between the two face centres around it; over the step height S
